title: 100% Source Waste Segregation at Home
description: Separate wet organic waste from dry recyclable plastic, glass, and electronic waste before handing over to municipal sanitation workers.
freedomFighterConnection: Mahatma Gandhi's vision of Swachhata (Cleanliness as a personal & civic duty).

title: Buy Local Artisans & Swadeshi Products First
description: Choose products made by Indian artisans, handloom weavers, local farmers, and MSMEs for at least 50% of monthly household purchases.
freedomFighterConnection: Swadeshi Movement championed by Lokmanya Tilak & Mahatma Gandhi.

title: Water Conservation & Rainwater Harvesting
description: Fix leaking household taps, install low-flow aerators, and set up simple rooftop rainwater recharge pipes.
freedomFighterConnection: Reclaiming natural resources for collective community survival.

title: Digital Literacy Mentorship (Teach 5 Elders/Vendors)
description: Help local street vendors set up UPI QR codes, teach grandparents how to access DigiLocker or Ayushman Bharat IDs safely.
freedomFighterConnection: Shaheed Bhagat Singh's call to youth for active social awakening and education.

title: Build Open Source & Civic Tech Solutions
description: Participate in hackathons, contribute code to open-source public tools, or solve local municipal problems using data & AI.
freedomFighterConnection: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's vision of young technological pioneers driving national progress.

title: CSR Alignment with Aspirational Districts
description: Direct Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funds towards skill centers, solar water pumps, and maternal health in underdeveloped districts.
freedomFighterConnection: Mahatma Gandhi's Trusteeship model for business leaders.

title: Eliminate Single-Use Plastic in Supply Chain
description: Replace non-biodegradable packaging materials with hemp, jute, or paper alternatives across all warehouse shipping.
freedomFighterConnection: Protecting the sacred land and environment of the motherland.

title: Apprenticeship & Paid Internships for Tier 2/3 Youth
description: Provide hands-on vocational apprenticeships and fair stipends to students from rural technical institutes and ITIs.
freedomFighterConnection: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose's drive for national industrial discipline & youth participation.

title: Organize Monthly Community Health & Blood Donation Drives
description: Set up free preventive health screening and organ/blood donation camps in residential neighborhoods or panchayats.
freedomFighterConnection: Swami Vivekananda's principle: 'Service to man is service to God'.

title: Urban Forests (Miyawaki) & Community Kitchen Gardens
description: Transform vacant community plots into dense native plant micro-forests and organic vegetable patches.
